messages:
Maya (Support): FYI we just got paging from Hygea staging — embed API returning 429s and some 502s during their onboarding run. Customer's DBA is in the channel, asking for a quick plan.

Maya (Support): ```
2026-03-22T11:07:05Z embed-svc status=429 tenant=hygea env=staging pool=eu-west-2
2026-03-22T11:08:12Z proxy status=502 upstream=embed-svc tenant=hygea
```

cli-bot: Created incident HY-INC-223 (priority: P2) - elevated error rate for tenant hygea in staging.

Noah - CSM: Thanks Maya. Noah here. How bad is onboarding flow? Are they blocked from completing the checklist? This team is part of Q2 conversion cohort.

Maya (Support): Onboarding pipeline fails at "validate_embeddings" step for ~30% of requests. They can't finish automated checks; manual workarounds possible but slow. Customer flagged renewals team as worried.

Priya - CS Ops: Looping in SRE. Priya will draft comms once we know impact surface. Is prod safe?

Leo (SRE): Prod unaffected. Root cause looks like a scheduled CI job hitting staging with many parallel tiny batches (concurrency ~120). Our per-tenant concurrency cap was breached and backpressure caused proxy 502s. No model or config change in last 72h. Traces: trace/hygea/1799239999.

Noah - CSM: Proposed immediate actions: (1) Temp raise concurrency cap for hygea staging to 200 for 1hr, (2) Pause their CI job if possible, (3) Short customer message acknowledging and giving ETA.

Maya (Support): Action 1 applied (cap 80->200) at 11:15 UTC. Paused alert notifications for 30m. Seeing error rate drop to ~3% within 4m.

Priya - CS Ops: Draft comms for Hygea staging contact: "Hi Sam — we saw transient failures in your staging embeddings run caused by a CI burst. We've applied a temporary cap increase and are monitoring. Prod unchanged. ETA for final reversion: 60m. If you'd like, we can reschedule your onboarding run or rerun checks after stability." Thoughts?

Noah - CSM: Short and clear. Add one line: "If this workload is expected regularly, we can propose a paid quota plan to avoid future interruptions."

Priya - CS Ops: Added. Sending message now. @Maya please note any customer tone change; I'll track in the renewal risk queue.

Maya (Support): Customer reply: "Thanks — staging looks green now. We'll throttle CI and reach out about permanent quota. Appreciate the quick fix."

Noah - CSM: Great. Follow-ups: (a) Priya to add "staging embed burst" flag to renewal playbook, (b) SRE to revert cap after 60m unless extended, (c) CSM to proactively propose quota options pre-conversion.

Leo (SRE): Reversion scheduled at 12:15 UTC. I've left a note in HY-INC-223 and attached traces.

cli-bot: HY-INC-223 updated -> monitoring.

Priya - CS Ops: Captured notes and added checklist item: "If staging embed error rate >10% during onboarding -> escalate support->CS with temporary mitigation and quota recommendation." I'll also add snippet to renewal handoff deck.

Noah - CSM: Closing loop for now. If customer opts for quota change, we'll open a pricing/ops ticket and update renewal forecast.
